# Files kept from the Vectorscan release archive: destination (under
# src/vendor/vectorscan/) then source (in the archive). Paths are unchanged
# from upstream's layout, so the two columns are equal.
#
# The trim keeps what the CMake build of the hs and hs_runtime targets reads:
# CMakeLists.txt and cmake/, src/, include/boost-patched/, util/ (which
# CMakeLists.txt adds unconditionally), the libhs.pc.in and .def files, and
# the licence, changelog and readme files, and scripts/ and the cppcheck
# suppression list that upstream's CMake references. Left out: unit/,
# tools/, examples/, benchmarks/, doc/, chimera/ and the empty simde/
# submodule directory. tools/vendor/fetch copies exactly this list; tools/vendor/verify
# fails if the tree and the list disagree in either direction.
#
# src/parser/Parser.rl.cpp and src/parser/control_verbs.rl.cpp are not
# listed: they are generated by fetch (the manifest's `generated` column).
